title: How is Julius Caesar linked to Sonic?
description: Rome's first emperors, a Renaissance fresco, the line of popes, a Vatican audience and The Tonight Show connect Julius Caesar to Sonic the Hedgehog.
hook: What links Julius Caesar to Sonic?

links.line: In 2013, Peter's line of popes reached its 266th, Pope Francis.
In 2024, the pope hosted over a hundred comedians, including Jimmy Fallon.
Two months later, Fallon welcomed actor Ben Schwartz onto The Tonight Show.
And since 2020, Schwartz has been the movie voice of Sonic.
